headline: NVARC3 noses past Turducken as the juggernaut joins the chase

image.alt: The green GPU juggernaut carries its crew uphill ahead of Turducken’s brass mechanical chicken and complete crew, with two Yorkies; Chen’s two rabbits and Tufa’s three spider mascots watch from separate strongholds above.
image.caption: The NVARC3 juggernaut pulls ahead of Turducken’s mechanical chicken on the climb toward the rabbits and spider citadel.

sections.heading: A narrow pass for fourth
sections.text: NVARC3 has edged past Team Turducken into fourth on the ARC-AGI-3 public board. At 56.15 against 56.02, the margin is thirteen hundredths of a point. The juggernaut has its nose in front; Turducken is still right there.

sections.heading: Six points and four places
sections.text: The move landed overnight Sunday: NVARC3 rose from 49.89 to 56.15, vaulting from eighth to fourth. Four places in one surge. Turducken’s 56.02 had been enough for fourth; the challenger raised the price.

sections.heading: The podium is still up the mountain
sections.text: Next up is xz, third on 58.59, less than two and a half points beyond NVARC3. Higher up the mountain, Tufa Labs has 70.24 and Yi-Chia Chen @ Fields Model leads on 75.56. The first pass is made. The next target is already in view.

sections.heading: Champions in a larger crew
sections.text: Jean-François Puget (CPMP) and Ivan Sorokin won the 2025 ARC Prize together as NVARC. This year they are part of NVARC3’s seven-account crew, alongside Darragh Hanley, Gal Kaplun and their teammates. The former champions arrive at the final day with fresh momentum and a close fight on their hands.
